description: This file contains UI tests for the Search screen in an Android Jetpack Compose application. It uses the Compose Testing framework to verify UI behavior such as focus states, display of recent searches, search results with topics and news resources, and various UI messages under different states.

classes.name: SearchScreenTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the UI behavior of the Search screen using Jetpack Compose testing framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes string variables with resources fetched via getString() before each test.

methods.name: searchTextField_isFocused
methods.description: Verifies that the search text field gains focus on the Search screen.

methods.name: emptySearchResult_emptyScreenIsDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that the 'try another search' message is displayed when search results are empty.

methods.name: emptySearchResult_nonEmptyRecentSearches_emptySearchScreenAndRecentSearchesAreDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies that recent searches and clear button are visible when there are recent search queries.

methods.name: searchResultWithTopics_allTopicsAreVisible_followButtonsVisibleForTheNumOfFollowedTopics
methods.description: Ensures that all topics are visible and follow/unfollow buttons are correctly displayed for each topic.

methods.name: searchResultWithNewsResources_firstNewsResourcesIsVisible
methods.description: Checks that news resources are displayed correctly when search results include news items.

methods.name: emptyQuery_notEmptyRecentSearches_verifyClearSearchesButton_displayed
methods.description: Verifies the clear recent searches button and search queries display when search query is empty.

methods.name: searchNotReady_verifySearchNotReadyMessageIsVisible
methods.description: Checks that a 'search not ready' message is shown when search is in a not ready state.
